name: – Anna Strolenberg – After § 71 – Am 44
title: REPORT on the situation of fundamental rights in the European Union in 2024 and 2025
part_text: 71a. Underlines that healthcare policies must be grounded in respect for the intrinsic dignity of every human being; highlights the importance of respecting the right to conscientious objection, in accordance with national legal frameworks; calls for the promotion of healthcare approaches that take into account the protection of human life from conception and the well-being of both the mother and the child, in full respect of the competences of the Member States in the field of health;
